outline: The thermodynamics of phase diagrams and phase transformations. Solution thermodynamics of multi-component and partial molar properties. Applications of thermodynamics to the analysis, design and computer simulation of metallurgical processes.
schedule:
week 1-4: Chap. 2-4, 6 Review for First, Second, Third Law of Thermodynamics
week 5-7: Chap. 5 Auxiliary functions , Chap. 7 Phase equilibrium
week 9: Midterm exam
week 10-11: Chap. 8/9 Gas behavior/ Solutions
week 12-14: Chap. 10/15 Phase diagram, phase transformation/ spinodal decomposition, nucleation and growth
week 15-17: Chap. 11-13 Reactions, defect reactions
week 18: Final exams
assessment:
40% assignment and class performance
30% midterm exam
30% final exam

All assignments are given and scored via TEAMS.microsoft.com. No paper hand-in is accepted.
